candidates.change_summary: Removed the initialization guard so SetMinSum no longer reverts when intitalized is true (deleted the revert check), allowing MinSum to be changed even after initialization.
Inverted the guard so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when intitalized is true (changed if condition), preventing changes before initialization.
Removed the non-reentrancy protection by deleting the require and locked_ assignments, making the modifier a no-op which may allow reentrant calls that alter MinSum unexpectedly.

Made the modifier permanently lock by removing the unlock step (deleted the trailing locked_ = false), causing functions using it (including SetMinSum) to become unusable after first call so MinSum cannot be changed further.
Remove the initialization-check revert so SetMinSum can be changed even after initialized is true.

Replace the revert guard with a require that allows setting only when initialized is false (semantic change: revert -> require message omitted but behavior similar), preserving nonReentrant_; this changes observable revert behavior stringlessness but still prevents setting when initialized is true (kept for completeness but is a different statement).
Remove the state reset at the end of the modifier so locked_ remains true after function execution, preventing subsequent SetMinSum calls (observable change to SetMinSum after first call).
Removed the guard that prevents SetLogFile after initialization by deleting the revert check, allowing SetLogFile to change Log even when intitalized is true.
Changed the function to only set Log when intitalized is true (inverted condition), so after calling SetLogFile when intitalized is false nothing changes, altering observable state.
Made the nonReentrant_ modifier ineffective by removing the locking behavior (require omitted), allowing reentrant calls that could change whether SetLogFile takes effect.
Set intitalized to false instead of true in C.Initialized(), so calling Initialized() clears the flag rather than setting it.
Toggle intitalized in C.Initialized(), making the call flip the flag (true->false, false->true) instead of always setting to true.
Remove setting locked_ = true so modifier no longer prevents reentrancy by not marking entry; only resets locked_ after function executes.
Set locked_ = false at entry (bug) so the reentrancy guard is disabled by ensuring locked_ is cleared before and after call, allowing nested calls that can change intitalized behavior.
